name: Assisted Dips
instructions: Set the assisted dip/pull-up machine's counterweight to the amount of assistance you need, then kneel or step onto the platform and grip the parallel handles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your torso upright and elbows close to your sides.
Press back up through your palms until your arms are fully extended, without locking out aggressively.
Repeat for the desired number of reps, lowering the assistance weight over time as you get stronger.
